definitions.accuracy_delta_pp: 100 * (candidate test accuracy - paired baseline test accuracy)
definitions.tensor_storage: All unique physical parameter/buffer storage, including untouched operators and bias
definitions.equal_budget: Equal whole-model tensor storage; coincides with equal rank in these biased float32 factors
definitions.analytical_macs: Per-example multiply-accumulates from fixed operator dimensions/ranks; excludes bias and activations
definitions.seed_spread: Sample standard deviation and observed range across 3 paired seeds, not confidence intervals
definitions.construction_cost: fixed method order within architecture worker; first import/cache overhead charged to actual first consumer; no isolated per-method cold-cost ranking
definitions.conditional_break_even: ceil(total measured candidate creation/validation/export seconds / observed batch median time saving); conditional scenario, not measured payback
definitions.memory: Sampled recursive tree RSS may double-count shared pages; not an exact allocation or resident peak
